_comment: Committed contract for the extraction eval. Measured 2026-07-23 on openai/gpt-4.1-mini (chain default), identical across two consecutive runs after the calendar-prompt fix: invoice 21/21 = 1.000, calendar 10/10 = 1.000, offer 5/5 = 1.000. The prior 0.75 calendar floor absorbed a reproducible defect where the chain emitted event_name in the wrong language (Russian, for an English message) because only the Cyrillic branch of the calendar prompt's language_hint had an explicit language instruction; the English branch now has an equally explicit one. Raising a floor after a green run locks the gain in; lowering one accepts a regression and must be its own reviewable diff.
_comment_waste_forms: Waste-form chains added 2026-07-28. Of the three reproducible defects originally absorbed here, the transport one is fixed and its floor is raised; the two identification ones remain. The golden cases assert correct behaviour, so each surviving defect stays printed as a MISS on every run until it is fixed. FIXED 2026-07-28 — (1) transport ext-tf-en-full: disposal_place_name was not extracted from 'at the X landfill', only from 'на/до депонија X'. The transport prompt now names both language surfaces and says to drop the generic word ('landfill'/'депонија') from the facility name. transport_form went 46/47 = 0.979 -> 47/47 = 1.000, reproduced across two consecutive runs, and its floor is raised 0.95 -> 1.0. OPEN — (2) identification ext-idf-en-full: waste_type is not extracted at all from an English message, which also costs ewc_code and is_hazardous (3 misses from one cause), even though the other three closed lists snap from English correctly in the same call. (3) identification ext-idf-mk-unmapped-waste, the serious one: glass waste is paraphrased onto 'Отпад од пластика' and ships fabricated code 02 01 04 on a legal document. _resolve_ewc_code_from_waste_type only blanks the code fields when the model OMITS an unmatched waste_type; it cannot catch a paraphrase onto a real list entry, because the map lookup then succeeds.
_comment_waste_type_substitution: Warning for whoever fixes identification defect (3). While fixing the transport disposal_place gap, the first attempt worded the new rule as general 'recognise it in any phrasing, in either language' guidance. That bled across fields: the transport chain started paraphrasing unmapped glass waste onto 'Отпад од пластика' and shipping 02 01 04 — it acquired defect (3), which it had previously passed. Caught because ext-tf-mk-unmapped-waste asserts '@absent' and the regression was reproducible across two runs. The fix was to scope the phrasing rule to disposal_place_name explicitly AND add a standalone rule that an off-list waste must be omitted, never replaced by the nearest option. Prompt edits in these chains are not field-local; re-run the eval and read the per-chain deltas, not just the pass/fail.
